title: Old Man in Vieques
content: I met this old guy in Vieques and sketched his portrait. We were sitting across the street from a ruined building that used to be a sugar cane factory. He used to work there when he was young, but it closed down in this area 60 years ago.Now the area is home to wild horses. But they're not really wild because people feed them. Hurricane Hugo killed hundreds of them, he said.
